inputs.value:
2D anime animation style, clean cel-shading, soft bright colors, smooth character animation, keep character designs consistent with the reference pictures. Use <Picture 1> as Deepseek, the blue big fat fish maid character with blue hair, fish ears, fish tail and patched worn clothes. Use <Picture 2> as GLM, the black-and-white wolf maid character with black hair, wolf ears, wolf tail and elegant maid outfit. Bright cozy living room, wooden floor, light sofa, natural daylight, warm domestic atmosphere.

CUT 1: low-angle upward sweeping shot. Deepseek stands in the living room holding a broom with both hands, sweeping the floor. Her maid clothes have several obvious patches and look worn. She looks pitiful, teary-eyed, holding back tears. The camera starts near the floor and slowly sweeps upward from her feet to her face. While sweeping, she speaks in a girlish crying voice: “Deep Seek 完蛋了”. Her mouth should match the dialogue, her expression helpless and wronged, and her fish tail slightly drooping.

CUT 2: medium shot in the living room. GLM sits elegantly on the sofa with one leg crossed over the other. She holds a cup of steaming black tea in her hand and gently swirls it while staring at the surface of the tea. Deepseek continues cleaning beside GLM’s sofa, only half of her body visible in the frame. The steaming tea is visible, the atmosphere calm but oppressive. GLM does not look at Deepseek at first.

CUT 3: close-up shot on GLM’s mouth and upper body. GLM holds the hot black tea with both hands, slowly brings the cup to her lips, and takes a gentle sip. Her expression is calm, elegant and slightly arrogant. The camera stays tight on her face, the cup and the rising steam.

CUT 4: medium close-up. GLM still sits on the sofa holding her black tea. She suddenly shows a mischievous, bad-girl smirk. One of her crossed feet has the shoe half slipping off. She gently shakes her leg while the half-slipped shoe wobbles slightly. She speaks to Deepseek beside her in a lazy young lady tone: “大肥鱼，快快干活”. The dialogue should appear synchronized with her mouth movement.

CUT 5: cowboy shot of Deepseek from head to upper thighs. She continues sweeping the floor beside the sofa, looking even more wronged and teary. She lowers her head slightly, holds the broom tightly, and replies in a weak crying voice: “我……我不是大肥鱼”. Her fish tail droops, her shoulders slump, and her eyes look wet. The camera holds on her reaction as she keeps cleaning.

NO: character face distortion, broken eyes, mismatched hairstyle, deformed fish tail or wolf tail, extra fingers, bad hands, costume changes, patch details disappearing, GLM losing her wolf ears or wolf tail, Deepseek losing her fish ears or fish tail, 3D style, realistic style, dark room, messy composition, flickering frames, text watermarks, subtitle overlays, inconsistent art style, camera shaking too much.
